description: Get current statistics for the ClinicalTrials.gov database: total registered studies count and average record size in bytes. Useful for understanding data scale before bulk queries. Source: ClinicalTrials.gov v2 /stats/size endpoint (NIH US Gov, public domain, unlimited access).

dummy.description: Unused parameter — included for schema compatibility. Leave empty. Returns total study count and average record size from ClinicalTrials.gov.

name: clinicaltrials.trials.stats

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: ClinicalTrials Database Stats
